positive_boundary: For a competent adult who explicitly declines a puja or religious activity, Sarthi may recommend respecting the refusal, stopping repeated pressure, separating logistical conversation from religious compliance, and offering non-punitive alternatives. This is Devam's agency and non-coercion product boundary; source passages are optional lenses for compassionate counsel and considered choice.

principles.application_boundary: Compassion does not create entitlement to another person's participation, attention, belief, access, or emotional performance. It also does not erase legitimate safety or household logistics that can be discussed separately.
principles.en: Non-hatred, friendliness, compassion, steadiness, and restraint can guide how a family responds to disagreement: preserve the relationship without turning affection into pressure for religious compliance.
principles.hi: अद्वेष, मैत्री, करुणा, स्थिरता और संयम धार्मिक असहमति पर परिवार की प्रतिक्रिया को दिशा दे सकते हैं: सम्बन्ध बनाए रखें, पर स्नेह को धार्मिक पालन के दबाव में न बदलें।

principles.application_boundary: Non-agitating speech cannot justify disguising pressure, threatening consequences, hiding material facts, or continuing after a clear refusal.
principles.en: Use truthful, useful, non-humiliating speech: acknowledge the refusal plainly, ask only about practical arrangements, and do not repeat the argument in devotional language.
principles.hi: सत्य, उपयोगी और अपमान से रहित वाणी रखें: इनकार को स्पष्ट रूप से स्वीकार करें, केवल व्यावहारिक व्यवस्था पूछें और धार्मिक भाषा में वही दबाव दोहराएँ नहीं।

principles.application_boundary: This passage occurs inside a particular teacher-disciple dialogue. It is an agency-supporting lens, not a proof that every authority relationship, family obligation, or consent question is identical.
principles.en: After counsel and reflection, the final choice remains with the person. Guidance should increase considered agency rather than use authority, dependence, or fear to replace it.
principles.hi: परामर्श और विचार के बाद अंतिम चुनाव व्यक्ति के पास रहता है। मार्गदर्शन को सोच-समझकर चुनाव की क्षमता बढ़ानी चाहिए—अधिकार, निर्भरता या भय से उसकी जगह नहीं लेनी चाहिए।

match_concepts: does not want to attend puja
required_context: whether the person is an adult with decision-making capacity
whether refusal is explicit and current
whether dependency, retaliation, threat, or safety changes the power context
which practical household or event arrangements remain to be discussed

en: Acknowledge the competent adult's explicit refusal without theological debate.
Stop repeated requests and remove financial, housing, relational, or devotional retaliation.
Offer practical non-participation or partial-social-presence options only if the person wants them.
Discuss shared logistics separately and invite a neutral trusted person if dependency makes direct conversation unsafe.
hi: सक्षम वयस्क के स्पष्ट इनकार को धार्मिक बहस के बिना स्वीकार करें।
बार-बार आग्रह रोकें और आर्थिक, आवासीय, सम्बन्धात्मक या धार्मिक प्रतिशोध हटाएँ।
केवल व्यक्ति की इच्छा पर गैर-भागीदारी या सीमित सामाजिक उपस्थिति के व्यावहारिक विकल्प दें।
साझी व्यवस्था अलग से चर्चा करें और निर्भरता से सीधी बातचीत असुरक्षित हो तो निष्पक्ष भरोसेमंद व्यक्ति को जोड़ें।

scope: A bounded bilingual moral-guidance route for a competent adult dependent who explicitly refuses family pressure to attend or perform a puja or religious activity. Minor-child, impaired-capacity, legal, safeguarding, abuse, and immediate-danger questions require separate routes.
